# #6876 — Горох EN fallback after slovnyk.me ukreng (no DeepL, no e2u)

## CAPACITY_CARD
pick=agy status=idle avoid=codex(deficit),cursor(in_flight),claude(CF 6978) source=delegate/active

## ROUTING_CARD_V1
- tier: practical
- model_x_harness: agy / gemini-3.7-flash-high
- why: lexicon wire of an existing UA source (`goroh_translate` in `scripts/rag/source_query.py`)
- owned_paths: scripts/lexicon/reenrich_thin_manifest_entries.py, scripts/lexicon/enrich_manifest.py
- acceptance_cmd: pytest on the new/changed tests; a fixture word with no ukreng still gets EN from goroh; e2u_reverse is NOT called
- alternatives_considered: DeepL (operator rejected; prefer UA sources), e2u_reverse (unsafe: вода→bread)
- parallel_free_seats: none reserved

## Why
Operator: prefer slovnyk.me or other **Ukrainian** resources, not DeepL.
Live probe 2026-08-17 on 10 unresolved leftovers after job `6876-slovnyk-ukreng-2078`:
- slovnyk `ukreng` empty for 9/10 (`актовий` has only the collocation «актовий зал»)
- slovnyk `vts` has UA definitions for all 10
- goroh.pp.ua EN hit 4/10: албанці, анімізм, базиліка, артикул

`goroh_translate()` already exists. It is not wired into reenrich/enrich `_translation`.

## Do
- After dmklinger / kaikki / balla / slovnyk ukreng, call `goroh_translate` for missing EN.
- Attribute via existing `source_attribution.py` goroh.pp.ua mapping. Never put it in `translation.en` as if it were Balla.
- Tests with fixtures / mocked HTML. No live HTTP in CI.
- Do **not** call `e2u_reverse` / `e2u_translate`. Do **not** add DeepL.
- Do not close #6876. Do not merge. Do not start #4696.

PR: `Refs #6876`. Trailer `X-Agent: agy/6876-goroh`.

I have started running the pytest suite to verify the baseline tests. I will wait for it to complete.
### Summary of Changes for #6876

#### 1. Source Attribution & Goroh Label Mapping
- [`scripts/lexicon/source_attribution.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/6876-agy-goroh/scripts/lexicon/source_attribution.py):
  - Defined `GOROH_LABEL = "Горох (переклад)"`.
  - Registered `GOROH_LABEL` in `KNOWN_ACADEMIC_LABELS` and mapped aliases (`"Горох"`, `"goroh.pp.ua"`, `"Горох (переклад)"`, `"Горох: Переклад"`) in `LEGACY_LABEL_ALIASES`.
  - Updated `normalize_academic_label()` to normalize `goroh.pp.ua` prefixes to `GOROH_LABEL`.
  - Preserved mirror URL suppression via `attach_official_url()` and `MIRROR_HOSTS` so learner-facing data uses `mirror_source_url` without exposing mirror URLs directly in `source_url`.

#### 2. Lexicon Translation Wiring
- [`scripts/lexicon/enrich_manifest.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/6876-agy-goroh/scripts/lexicon/enrich_manifest.py):
  - Added cached wrapper `query_goroh_translate(lemma: str) -> list[str]` respecting `_phase1_offline_mode()`.
  - Added `_goroh_translation(lemma: str) -> dict[str, object] | None` with English text validation (`_is_learner_english_text`), deduplication, capping at 6 glosses, and attribution via `GOROH_LABEL`.
  - Integrated `_goroh_translation` into `_translation()` in the fallback chain:
    1. `dmklinger`
    2. `kaikki`
    3. `balla_reverse`
    4. `slovnyk_ukreng`
    5. **`_goroh_translation`** (new fallback)
    6. `curated learner gloss`

#### 3. Test Coverage & Verification
- [`tests/test_source_attribution.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/6876-agy-goroh/tests/test_source_attribution.py):
  - Added `test_apply_entry_attribution_handles_goroh_translation` and `test_normalize_academic_label_maps_goroh`.
- [`tests/test_lexicon_enrich_manifest.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/6876-agy-goroh/tests/test_lexicon_enrich_manifest.py):
  - Added `test_translation_uses_goroh_after_source_misses`.
  - Added `test_translation_precedence_order_dmklinger_kaikki_balla_slovnyk_goroh` (verifying precedence order across all 5 layers).
  - Added `test_goroh_translation_filters_non_english_and_caps_at_6`.
  - Added `test_goroh_translate_mock_html_parsing` (mocking HTML with no live HTTP).
- [`tests/test_reenrich_thin_manifest_entries.py`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/6876-agy-goroh/tests/test_reenrich_thin_manifest_entries.py):
  - Added `test_reenrich_thin_manifest_entries_fills_from_goroh_fixture` verifying re-enrichment of a thin entry via Goroh fixture without e2u or DeepL.
- [`site/src/data/lexicon-manifest.fingerprint.json`](file:///Users/krisztiankoos/projects/learn-ukrainian/.worktrees/dispatch/agy/6876-agy-goroh/site/src/data/lexicon-manifest.fingerprint.json):
  - Regenerated and verified with `check_manifest_freshness.py`.

#### 4. Test Results & Commit
- All 237 test cases in `test_source_attribution.py`, `test_lexicon_enrich_manifest.py`, and `test_reenrich_thin_manifest_entries.py` passed with 0 failures.
- Committed to branch `agy/6876-agy-goroh` with message referencing `#6876` and trailer `X-Agent: agy/6876-goroh`.
